subject.title: Control UI: Config upgrade/hardening suggestions should apply changes automatically with before/after diff and user acceptance, not direct users to edit files manually

question: Which Control UI config/security recommendations may write user config, and what confirmation, audit, restart, redaction, and dismissal policy must gate those writes?
rationale: The implementation would let browser-originated guidance change auth-related configuration, so automation should not choose the security boundary or product policy without maintainer intent.

options.title: Allowlisted Recommendation Actions
options.body: Approve a narrow reusable UI pattern for vetted recommendations that routes through existing config validation and requires before/after diff acceptance before applying.

options.title: Keep Guidance Read-Only
options.body: Leave hardening recommendations as text/docs only and avoid UI-originated mutation for auth/security settings.

options.title: Defer Fixes To Doctor
options.body: Make doctor or upgrade-scan the canonical fixer and have the Control UI link users there instead of applying patches itself.

recommendation.title: Allowlisted Recommendation Actions
recommendation.body: Approve a narrow reusable UI pattern for vetted recommendations that routes through existing config validation and requires before/after diff acceptance before applying.

likelyOwner.reason: This is primarily a security/product boundary choice, and steipete has the strongest observed adjacent history around dangerous config warnings and config/security posture.
